subject: CS241
filterSummary: Filtered out 348 candidates: low relevance (off-topic, loosely related), wrong audio language (Hindi, Telugu, French, etc.), too short (<60s) or too long (>3600s), and duplicate channels per topic. Retained the best 10 educational videos (5 EN, 5 AR) across the five topics, skipping topics with insufficient quality (e.g., Principle of Equivalence in AR, Moore's Law in AR).
